metaDescription: Shop custom PL wine tumblers at Perfect Imprints. Personalize with your logo for events or giveaways. Order bulk today!
introHtml: Custom PL wine tumblers combine the elegance of stemless glassware with durable plastic construction, making them a smart choice for outdoor events, trade shows, and corporate parties. Unlike standard wine glasses, these shatter-resistant tumblers are lightweight and portable, ideal for venues where glass is not allowed. Choose from designs like the 16 oz Govino® Wine Glass or the 12 oz Plastic Vinello Stemless Wine Glass, and add your logo with screen printing or full-color wrap for memorable branded giveaways.
heroAltText: Custom PL wine tumblers with company logo printed on plastic stemless glasses for outdoor events
